description: This file contains multiple classes related to Orleans streaming grains, including producer and consumer grains, and observer classes for handling stream events in a testing environment.

classes.name: SampleConsumerObserver<T>
classes.description: An observer for ingesting stream items, handling OnNext, OnCompleted, and OnError events.

classes.name: SampleStreaming_ProducerGrain
classes.description: A grain that produces stream items periodically and manages stream lifecycle.

classes.name: SampleStreaming_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain that consumes streaming data via subscription and tracks received items.

classes.name: SampleStreaming_InlineConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain that subscribes inline to stream events with direct callback methods, suitable for testing or inline processing.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles receiving the next stream item.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Sets up the grain as a stream producer.

methods.name: StartPeriodicProducing
methods.description: Starts a timer to produce stream items periodically.

methods.name: GetNumberProduced
methods.description: Returns the count of items produced.

methods.name: ClearNumberProduced
methods.description: Resets the count of produced items.

methods.name: Produce
methods.description: Triggers production of a stream item.

methods.name: TimerCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked by the timer to produce items.

methods.name: Fire
methods.description: Sends a stream item asynchronously, updating context and logging.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain as a stream consumer.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Unsubscribes the consumer from the stream.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the number of consumed items.

methods.name: OnNextAsync (InlineConsumerGrain)
methods.description: Handles incoming stream items with inline callback.
